scope: Independent recomputation of three Round 25 screen-a candidates, two blocks each, projected through public #595 primary and shadow controls. No causal decomposition, CI invocation, root analyze/rank script invocation, new gate, or submission action.

formula.raw_time_ratio: arithmetic mean over 28 files of median(measured total_s candidate)/median(measured total_s incumbent)
formula.raw_mean_compression_pct: arithmetic mean over 28 files of 100 * output_bytes/raw_bytes
formula.projection_time: current official #595 balanced_time_ratio * raw candidate time ratio / same-block #595-control raw time ratio
formula.projection_size: current official #595 mean_file_compression_pct * raw candidate mean compression pct / same-block #595-control mean compression pct
formula.scoring: captured official pure scorer local_global_improvement_space_log_weights over current snapshot frontier plus projected candidate; share = 100 * policy pareto_share * candidate weight
formula.strict_first: candidate post-insertion geometric allocation is strictly greater than every other post-insertion frontier allocation; ties do not count

limits: Two blocks on one CI runner are not independent multi-runner confirmation or a success probability.
The #595 primary/shadow coordinates are conditional projections onto current snapshot 29673, not new official submissions or formal admission outcomes.
Snapshot metadata reports freshness=unknown; captured public scorer source does not prove exact live deployment identity.
The artifact manifest hash-checks extracted files; the recorded GitHub ZIP digest was not independently recomputed from a downloaded archive.
This audit addresses numerical aggregation and scorer projections only; it does not explain timing causes or verify a new Lean gate.
